lines: Ahoy, landlubber! So you're the one the Crown keeps sending ahead of the storm.
Shelldrift's barely holding together. The tides bring corruption inland — ruins surface that were better left drowned.
Every salvage run gets worse. Whatever's down in those depths, it's angry.
Set up shop and make yourself useful. We need supplies more than speeches.
The Sunken Strand contains ruins of... historical significance to the realm.
Ensure nothing of value is lost to the tides. Report any unusual artifacts or inscriptions.
This is a matter of Crown interest. Details will follow as appropriate.
dialogs.notes: First direct King communication. Oddly specific about ruins. Plants suspicion.

lines: Say, Shopkeeper... strange folk been asking about old ruins down there.
Royal types. Before you even arrived.
Makes a sailor wonder what the Crown really wants from these depths.
The Crown sent you here specifically, didn't they?
dialogs.notes: First visual manifestation — dark silhouette that flickers. No longer dismissive. Curious.

lines: Shopkeeper. His Majesty wishes to know — did you find anything unusual in the depths?
Artifacts? Inscriptions? Anything... out of the ordinary?
Very well. I will relay your report.
Proceed to the Ashen Horizons. The corruption there... accelerates.
dialogs.notes: Cedric shows visible relief when Shopkeeper has nothing specific. But also confusion. First sign he doesn't know everything.
